items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Billie said, yes, let him off here and let him play his little horn. I said that is right, darlin', that is what I wants to do.

ctx.x: 7th Avenue and 141st Street. So, I said they were going down there, down town and I said well, let me off here because I want to play a little bit.
Billie said, yes, let him off here and let him play his little horn. I said that is right, darlin', that is what I wants to do.
And they would give me a couple, a little of that stuff you know and I was right, man. I was right. So, I went in there now, who was playing? I think Sweets was playing.
